EmailTemplate.name: International Time - Non-Insperity Employee (ITA Only)
EmailTemplate.subject: International Time - Non-Insperity Employee (ITA Only)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for providing this information. This user has been approved through our Data Privacy Team and can be set up in Time & Attendance. I've provided a link to an article in our Help Center that details those steps:
https://help.insperity.com/bps/knowledge-base/how-to-add-a-new-employee-in-time-and-attendance/
As you follow these steps, keep in mind that the user should be assigned to a non-Insperity/non-exporting Client ID. This will ensure they are not included on your payroll export.
Once their setup is complete, the user will be able to log in directly to Time & Attendance via this URL, with the credentials you assign during setup:
https://timestar.insperity.com/XXX/
If you have additional questions or concerns about this setup, please feel free to contact our Time & Attendance Support Team for assistance.
Phone: 800-314-8223 (live support is available Monday - Friday 7 am - 7 pm Central Time)
Email: time.support@insperity.com
Please reference this case number {Case Number} so they know the approval has been completed for this user.
